answer: To deter Sybil attacks, our network enforces cryptographic stake burning where registering n agent identities requires burning fee S(n) = k * n^2. This superlinear cost scaling widens an economic canyon between honest operators and adversaries, making mass identity spoofing mathematically unviable. An attacker attempting to isolate an autonomous identity island faces quadratic token destruction, while consensus nodes verify identity legitimacy via on-chain pigment markers.
